declarations.description:
In-flow trigger for an action that happens now, in the current context — submit, save, confirm, open a dialog, fire async work — in the brand's primary action style, the expected look of a button. Not navigation (use Link, or give the button an href so it renders an <a>), not a persistent binary (Switch.Row), not one-of-many selection (SegmentedControl, or a toggle button). For a destructive or a weightless action, use the Button.Destructive / Button.Neutral sibling components.

Renders `@prism3/css`'s button markup in the light DOM: a native `<button class="p3-button">`, or an `<a href>`,
styled only by `@prism3/css/button.css`. Each prop of the def is a property of the same name, reflected to
`data-prop-<name>`. While pending or inactive a click is suppressed and focus is kept.
declarations.name: P3Button

members.name: #suppress
members.description: isPending and isInactive keep focus but suppress the action: no listener runs, no form submits, no link navigates.

members.name: label
members.description: Visible label; verb-first, sentence case, ≤3 words. Always required here — an icon-only control is the separate icon-button, which requires an accessible name instead.

members.name: onClick
members.description: Action handler. Suppressed while isPending or isInactive.

members.name: appearance
members.description: Visual treatment over the color, decoupled from intent so the matrix scales by addition. filled = interactive fill + on-fill ink; outline = border + text ink; text = ink only.

members.name: size
members.description: Control size — drives height, padding, and label type.

members.name: surface
members.description: The ground the button sits on. default for a normal page; inverse for a dark or brand-filled band, where the button binds its color.inverse counterparts so fill, ink, border, overlay and the disabled treatment keep contrast against the flipped surface. A host that cannot know its ground picks default, and the designer sets inverse on the instance — the same answer the nested focus ring gives.

members.name: inset
members.description: Text appearance only. flush removes the inline padding on both sides, so the label lines up with the content edge above and below it, whether the button starts, ends or centers a row. A flush button hovers by color only, and its hit target keeps its height.

members.name: fullWidth
members.description: Stretch to container. Aliases: block / isFullWidth.

members.name: type
members.description: Opinionated default 'button' to neutralize the platform's submit-on-enter-in-form trap; require 'submit' explicitly.

members.name: isPending
members.description: Delays the spinner, preserves width, keeps focus (aria-disabled, not native disabled), suppresses re-fire, announces busy. Preferred over a loading prop.

members.name: isInactive
members.description: Focusable disabled — visually muted, retains tab order, surfaces the blockage reason on focus. Use for a control blocked by satisfiable app state (e.g. submit on an incomplete form).

members.name: disabled
members.description: Native disabled. Reserved for controls fundamentally irrelevant to the current view; removes it from the tab order and the accessibility tree. Prefer isInactive for anything relevant-but-blocked.

members.name: leadingVisual
members.description: Icon / avatar / counter / spinner before the label.

members.name: trailingVisual
members.description: Icon / caret / indicator after the label.

members.name: href
members.description: A destination, for a navigation that needs a button's weight, such as "Continue to checkout". With an href, the button renders an <a href> in the same style, Enter follows it, and type and disabled no longer apply. Anything lighter is a Link.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Extends the visible label with context it does not carry ("Delete invoice 1042" on a "Delete" button). Start it with the visible text, so a voice-control user who speaks the label still activates the control (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name).

declarations.description:
A single-line control for free-form, non-enumerable text — names, emails, SKUs, short queries. A composed host: label + input + helper/validation message, with the accessibility wiring (id generation, aria-describedby chain, aria-invalid) handled internally. Not multi-line (Textarea), not a known set (Select, or a combobox), not numeric-formatted (a number field), not suggestion-backed (a combobox). The combobox and number field are not built yet.

Renders `@prism3/css`'s text-field markup in the light DOM: a native `<label for>` and `<input>` in one tree with the
message, styled only by `@prism3/css`. Each prop of the def is a property of the same name, reflected to
`data-prop-<name>`, except `value`, which is a property only.
Markup written inside the element before its script runs (the `@prism3/css` contract) is a working field on its own,
and is adopted on upgrade: its props, a typed value, and focus carry over.
declarations.name: P3TextField

members.name: label
members.description: The visible, persistent label (rendered as FieldLabel). Required — a visually-hidden label is the only label-less case, and it still exists in the DOM. Never the placeholder.

members.name: value
members.description: Controlled value; pair with onChange. A controlled value with no onChange is read-only by accident.

members.name: defaultValue
members.description: Uncontrolled initial value — preferred for form-library ergonomics.

members.name: onChange
members.description: Change handler (also onBlur / onFocus).

members.name: type
members.description: Attribute-only variants (mobile keyboard + autofill). Not number: numeric input needs a number field (not built yet). search / password are better served by their thin specializations.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: An example only ("name@example.com"); vanishes on input; nothing load-bearing lives here.

members.name: helpText
members.description: Persistent guidance (rendered as FieldMessage, default status); wired via aria-describedby. Show the format before failure.

members.name: validation
members.description: The validation state. Each non-default status swaps the input border to its own boundary (border-only — error → danger, warning → warning, success → success) and sets the nested message to the matching status; default is neutral. error also sets aria-invalid. The values align with FieldMessage's status axis, so this drives the nested message directly.

members.name: validationMessage
members.description: The validation text shown at error / warning / success, added to aria-describedby. For error, say what is wrong and how to fix it (SC 3.3.3), never "Invalid".

members.name: showMessage
members.description: Whether the composed FieldMessage is shown. Off by default; turn it on to render the helper or validation message below the input. Never hides a message the field needs: turn it on wherever there is helper or validation text.

members.name: required
members.description: Sets required / aria-required, and turns on the FieldLabel's required marker.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Native disabled — removed from tab order, not submitted, silent to assistive tech, contrast-exempt. Reserve for fields irrelevant in the current state.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Distinct from disabled: focusable, selectable and copyable, submitted with the form, and passes contrast. Use for a value the user may read/copy but not edit (a generated key). The component's live edge.

members.name: autoComplete
members.description: Satisfies SC 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose — an accessibility obligation, not a convenience.

members.name: inputMode
members.description: Selects the mobile virtual keyboard.

members.name: prefix
members.description: A leading text affix inside the field, before the value — a currency symbol or a unit ("$", "€"). Not part of the value and aria-hidden, so the label or helper text carries what it means. Follows the locale's placement (a symbol before or after the number). A glyph is leadingIcon, not this.

members.name: suffix
members.description: A trailing text affix inside the field, after the value — a unit or a domain ("kg", ".com"). Not part of the value and aria-hidden, so the label or helper text carries what it means. A glyph or a clear / reveal action is trailingIcon / clearable, not this.

members.name: leadingIcon
members.description: An optional leading glyph before the value (a purpose or category mark, such as search), aria-hidden and never the accessible name. Hidden by default; the file nominates the swap target. Signals the field's purpose; validation never mutates it.

members.name: trailingIcon
members.description: An optional trailing glyph at the field's trailing edge — a decorative mark (aria-hidden), or the glyph of a clear / reveal action, which in code is a focusable button with its own accessible name. The decorative-vs-interactive split is load-bearing. As a button, its hit area is at least 24×24 px, drawn around the 20px glyph, and adds no height to the field. Hidden by default; the file nominates the swap target.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Adds a labeled Clear button that announces the cleared state and returns focus to the input (the recurring trap is stranding focus).

members.name: isPending
members.description: Async validation/value — a spinner replaces an adornment without reflow; sets aria-busy; does not block typing unless intended.

members.name: size
members.description: Three tiers that scale the input type with the field (small 14px, medium 16px, large 18px, from type.body.sm, md and lg), the nested label one step below it (12 / 14 / 16), and the padding. Every size keeps the 44px target: small is smaller type and padding, not a smaller target; large is taller. small is for fine pointers only: on a coarse pointer (@media (pointer: coarse)) the code sets the small input to 16px, because iOS Safari zooms the page when it focuses an input under 16px. The field's edge, outline or underline, is the brand's Field style setting, not a prop.

members.name: id
members.description: Wiring + form submission; auto-generated with useId if omitted, tying label→input and the aria-describedby chain.

members.name: name
members.description: A real <input name> so the field works uncontrolled, in a native <form>, with useFormStatus / Server Actions, and the Constraint Validation API.

declarations.description:
A single-line field for a secret the user types — a sign-in password, a new password, a PIN typed as text. TextField's anatomy and contract with one added action: a Show/Hide button at the end of the label row that switches the input between masked and plain text. Not for a one-time code in separate boxes (CodeInput), and not for any other single-line text (TextField).

Renders `@prism3/css`'s password-field markup in the light DOM: a native `<label for>` and `<input>` in one tree with the
message, styled only by `@prism3/css`. Each prop of the def is a property of the same name, reflected to
`data-prop-<name>`, except `value`, which is a property only. The Show/Hide button switches the input between masked and plain text, keeps the caret and focus, announces the change, and returns to masked when the form submits.
Markup written inside the element before its script runs (the `@prism3/css` contract) is a working field on its own,
and is adopted on upgrade: its props, a typed value, and focus carry over.
declarations.name: P3PasswordField

members.name: #toggle
members.description:
Masked ↔ plain. The input's type is set at once and the caret put back; focus stays on the button. Chromium resets
the caret of an input that has had focus one task after its type changes while it is blurred (a click on this
button blurs it), so the caret is put back again after that task, but only while it sits at Chromium's reset 0,0:
a caret written since the press is kept (#3947), as the CSS package's script has done since #3945.

members.name: #onSubmit
members.description: Back to masked when the form submits (Q301.7 A), at once, so a browser never stores the value as plain text.
